meta.title: Load Sharing Enabled While Idle
description: Load sharing is enabled before any vehicle is plugged in, then both vehicles arrive.

Load sharing is a safety feature and must be safe to leave enabled permanently. An idle member is offered its minimum (keep-awake) rather than 0 A: a 0 A offer makes the shaper disable the port, a disabled port reports no vehicle, and the member could then never become demanding again.
Both peers must start charging after plugging in and settle on an equal share.
Group setup: 2 peers, 7,680 W shared supply, safety factor 1.0. Failsafe mode: safe_current.
